editorial:
Imagine you are spending your very last night in your hometown before moving away. You just want to have a few drinks and hang out with friends, but things go south fast. You find yourself being hunted by a creepy killer wearing a Mr Punch mask who seems to be everywhere at once. The movie does a great job of making you feel the tension as the night turns into a total nightmare. It starts off feeling like a normal party movie, but it quickly shifts into a game of cat and mouse that keeps you on the edge of your seat.

The acting is solid and the scares hit hard without being too over the top. While the plot is simple, the pacing is quick so you never get bored. Some parts might feel a bit predictable if you have seen a lot of slashers, but it is still a wild ride.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, you find out that the killer is actually someone close to the main character who held a grudge from the past. After a brutal fight, the girl manages to fight back and unmask the killer. She eventually kills him to save herself, ending the nightmare. The movie wraps up with her surviving the night, but she is left scarred by the experience as she finally leaves her hometown for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves slasher films and creepy masks.
